text_to_image_prompt: Generate one original cinematic environment photograph, landscape 3:2, full bleed, no collage, no borders, no captions. A richly observed film set with a specific emotional story, original architecture and arrangement, not a replica of a film frame. Vicky aesthetic: luminous high-key exposure with retained highlight detail, cream white, pale gray, warm natural brown, restrained pastel accents, broad soft daylight, filled low shadows, fine natural material texture and wear, very subtle film halation and grain, elegant believable photographic realism. Eye-level natural 50mm perspective, layered foreground/midground/background, gentle depth separation but environment clearly readable. Space reserved at central lower midground for future character compositing. ABSOLUTELY EMPTY ENVIRONMENT: no people, no characters, no animals, birds or insects, no human silhouettes, no human reflections, no hands, no faces on paintings, posters or screens, no statues or mannequins. No logos, watermarks, readable text. Avoid CGI real-estate renders, sterile showrooms, excessive bloom, orange grading, deep black shadows, ultrawide distortion. Scene: English countryside shortly after dawn in late spring, a small weathered pale stone footbridge crosses a narrow still stream at midground, softly curving footpath from lower right leads over it to a distant honey-stone manor partially hidden among trees. Soft rolling meadows and layers of thin silver morning mist; pale blue-white luminous sky, soft fresh sage greens, ivory wildflower patches. Camera standing beside a low worn timber gate in foreground, natural 50mm compression, no wide aerial view, an intimate navigable path and clear central stopping place on bridge. Soft front-side light through haze, no strong orange sunrise. Research inspiration: Pride & Prejudice's romantic English landscape and expressive natural light, newly designed setting. Emotion: a morning meeting that has not yet happened. No animals, birds or distant walkers whatsoever.
